texts.p1: To enhance students' capabilities to craft-making and enrich their extracurricular life, the craft-making activities will be held on the playground at 4 p.m. this Friday. I'm glad you are interested in the craft demonstrate and willing to give a hand.
texts.p2: The craftmen will show paper-cutting and bamboo weaving Of course, there are other activities on the playground. Let me keep a little secret for you.
texts.p3: You are willing to give a hand. We are so grateful. Can you help prepare seats and test audio equipment? We will gather the school hall at 2 p.m. this Friday.
